definitions.gloss: to remove, to take away, to eliminate
definitions.explanation: To completely remove something unwanted or unnecessary. Emphasizes thorough removal so that nothing remains.

examples.japanese: シミ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{去|さ}る。
⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦ペンキ→ペンキ：00342_penki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{去|さ}って⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{塗|ぬ}り{直|なお}した。
examples.english: I stripped off the old paint before repainting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{去|さ}る⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{根本的|こんぽんてき}→根本的：17920_konponteki⟧な⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}き{合|あ}う→向き合う：04652_mukiau⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: To eliminate long-standing anxiety, you need to face its root cause.

notes:
Godan verb ({五段動詞|ごだんどうし}), る-ending (godan, not ichidan).
- Negative: {取|と}り{去|さ}らない
- Polite: {取|と}り{去|さ}ります
- Te-form: {取|と}り{去|さ}って
- Past: {取|と}り{去|さ}った

USAGE:
Emphasizes complete removal with nothing left behind. Can be used both for physical removal (stains, objects) and abstract elimination (fears, obstacles). Somewhat more literary than ⟦{取|と}り{除|のぞ}く→取り除く：04222_torinozoku⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- シミ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{去|さ}る: to remove a stain
- ⟦{汚|よご}れ→汚れ：03186_yogore⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{去|さ}る: to remove dirt
- ⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{去|さ}る: to eliminate anxiety
- ⟦{障害|しょうがい}→障害：03228_shougai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{去|さ}る: to remove an obstacle

SIMILAR WORDS:
{取|と}り{去|さ}る emphasizes complete removal. ⟦{取|と}り{除|のぞ}く→取り除く：04222_torinozoku⟧ (to remove, to get rid of) is more common in everyday speech. ⟦{取|と}り{払|はら}う→取り払う：12069_toriharau⟧ (to clear away) emphasizes clearing or sweeping away.
